import ast,hashlib,pathlib,subprocess,sys,tempfile,unittest
k = {'source_kind': 'immutable Git blob; exact existing method AST only', 'git_revision': 'e6d3c3f0a80603e686bc59f591660a423f2d4f23', 'relative_path': 'tests/coder/test_daemon_safety.py', 'blob_sha256': '59a98f93743515ca04c00343869b4da70f1ad75bb2a0f0489fd5ab529be3d6e4', 'method_name': 'test_exclusive_lock_rejects_second_owner_and_releases', 'class_name': 'DaemonSafetyTests', 'method_ast_sha256': 'aa7ea266547fc43ce18293df2119744c740a22ec18618a2697e501f6c3896f90', 'matches_existing_reviewed_worktree_method': True, 'import_full_legacy_module': False}
canonical = pathlib.Path('E:\\opencode_harness_portable')
assert pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve() == canonical.resolve()
blob = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(canonical),'show',k['git_revision']+':'+k['relative_path']],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
assert blob.returncode == 0, blob.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
assert hashlib.sha256(blob.stdout).hexdigest() == k['blob_sha256'], 'Pinned blob hash mismatch'
t = ast.parse(blob.stdout.decode('utf-8-sig'))
c = next(n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name == k['class_name'])
f = next(n for n in c.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == k['method_name'])
assert hashlib.sha256(ast.dump(f,include_attributes=False).encode()).hexdigest() == k['method_ast_sha256'], 'Method AST hash mismatch'
sys.path.insert(0,str((canonical/'scripts/meta').resolve()))
import daemon_safety
assert pathlib.Path(daemon_safety.__file__).resolve() == (canonical/'scripts/meta/daemon_safety.py').resolve()
from daemon_safety import FileLease
ns = {'FileLease': FileLease}
exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[f],type_ignores=[])),k['git_revision']+':'+k['relative_path'],'exec'),ns)
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=r'C:\Temp\opencode')
try:
    C = type('IsolatedKernelLeaseTest',(unittest.TestCase,),{f.name:ns[f.name],'root':pathlib.Path(tmp.name)})
    suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(C)
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
finally:
    tmp.cleanup()
sys.exit(not(result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun == 1 and not result.skipped))
